items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tapoleon, canvas. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. They'd decorate all around the fences...

ctx.x: Vacant lot, clay, all of it nice. They'd take and put the Napoleon down on the lot. Put what down?

Oh, yeah. They'd decorate all around the fences, lights. Different colored lights? Different colored lights. Oh, yeah? Yeah. They'd have all their expressions, all their barrels that'd be packed in the back, you know? That was lawn parties. Oh, dancing, sure. Do they have dance floors or just dance on the floor? Dance on the canvas. No floor on the canvas. No floor on the canvas. Do they have a long table of some kind with anything to eat on it? Oh, yeah, they had long table of sandwiches and things. Long table…
